author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.18.3 — Fixes a cosmetic (non-functional) status mislabel confirmed live right after a room finished: status briefly showed 'Standby' instead of 'Docked' despite mode:Idle and charging:true both being correct, caused by charging being read from a separately-polled device attribute that can lag a poll behind mode. status now reads charge_state from the same status-poll payload as mode, removing that cross-poll race.
